# UNDERWRITING MEMORANDUM — FORMFACTOR, INC. (FORM)

**Prepared by:** Senior Underwriting Board | **As of:** 2026-10-05 | **Price T0:** $149.15 [Actual, vendor quote 2026-10-02]

---

## SECTION 0 — OVERVIEW

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Ticker / Company | FORM / FormFactor, Inc. (Semiconductor Equipment & Materials) |
| Price T0 | $149.15 [Actual] |
| Market cap | $11.68B [Actual] |
| **Verdict** | **OVERVALUED — AVOID** (no position at T0) |
| Base IV (p=0.50) | **$28.96** → MoS −80.6% |
| Bull IV (p=0.25) | **$36.78** → MoS −75.3% |
| Bear IV (p=0.25) | **$13.87** → MoS −90.7% |
| Probability-weighted IV | $27.14 → expected return −81.8% |
| Quarter-Kelly | 0.00% — NO_ALLOCATION (desk) |

The stock is +171.7% over 12 months [Actual, DATA 2.5] on an AI/HBM probe-card re-rating, now ~39x FY2027E consensus EPS [Estimate]. The desk's reverse DCF says the price implies **+101.3%/yr cash-flow growth in Base years 3–5** under my structure (+29.1% 10-year CAGR under the neutral reference). The company's own dated evidence — Q3 FY2026 guided to $270M ± $10M [Actual, PRIMARY P1] and a long-term model of $1.6B revenue / 55% GM / >$5 EPS by 2030 [Estimate, earnings call 2026-07-30] — supports roughly **+21%/yr** on my path. The price is paying for ~4x the growth the company itself projects, and no reachable discount rate, fade length, terminal growth or year-2 level inside the desk's bounds closes the gap. This is a structural overvaluation, not a hair's-breadth disagreement.

---

## SECTION 1 — MACRO

Facts that matter for FORM (DATA 1.5 / 1.6, as of 2026-10-01/04):

- **Rates:** 10y nominal 5.24%, real 2.88%, breakeven 2.36%; curve +0.45% (steepening); IG spread 1.49%. COE ANCHOR 10.46% (used, no departure).
- **Regime:** goldilocks headline at 0.341 but **contested** (margin 0.070); tightening 0.176, stagflation 0.130. News feed (2026-09-25): "Surging Treasury yields and persistent inflation are complicating Fed policy, with markets pricing possible additional rate hikes."
- **Active shock:** `oil_shock` (severity 1, up) since 2026-09-28 — Strait of Hormuz disruption, Saudi pipeline attack; CPI 3.35% / PCE 3.42% YoY.
- **Growth backdrop:** China August data show deepening slowdown (retail +0.4% y/y, FAI −7.2% Jan–Aug) [Unconfirmed news-feed figure].

**Exposure:** FORM at ~39x FY2027E EPS is a long-duration asset; higher-for-longer rates and an oil-driven inflation print compress exactly the multiple this stock trades on — the Sept 15–30 de-rating from ~$160 to ~$136 was this mechanism working before the Deutsche Bank pop reversed it. The oil shock transmits second-order: memory makers' (SK Hynix, Micron) capex budgets are rate-sensitive, and probe-card demand is a function of their test wafer starts. Direct China revenue exposure is limited (7.4% of FY2025 revenue [Actual, PRIMARY P3]). The bear scenario carries the macro shock explicitly as +200 bps on the discount rate.

---

## SECTION 2 — BUSINESS AND MOAT

**Economic engines (mandate 1):**

a) **Transactional deliveries — Probe Cards (~84% of H1 FY2026 revenue: $408.0M of $484.4M [Actual, PRIMARY P2]).** Consumable-ish test articles sold per test volume; the demand driver is advanced-node and HBM test intensity. H1 FY2026 mix: Foundry & Logic $233.0M, DRAM $167.9M (HBM now a large and growing share — Q2 DRAM record on "increased HBM4 demand" [Estimate, transcript 2026-07-30]; the brief's "~two-thirds of DRAM sales" figure is **[Unconfirmed]** from primary sources but directionally supported by South Korea revenue nearly doubling to $73.4M in Q2 [Actual, PRIMARY P2]).

b) **Captive installed base / annuity — weak.** Test Systems (handlers/automation, ~16% of revenue, 48.5% segment GM in Q2 [Actual, PRIMARY P2]) has some service content, but the filings show **no multi-year contracted backlog**: deferred revenue is $24.0M against ~$258M quarterly revenue (9%) [Actual, PRIMARY P1 balance sheet]. **There is no contracted floor to cite; the Bear scenario is therefore not constrained by one** (stated per mandate 4).

c) **Strategic optionality:** (i) Co-packaged optics line raised above $20M for FY2026, with a ~$400M CPO served market identified by 2030 [Estimate, earnings call via Yahoo Finance highlights, 2026-07-30]; (ii) Farmers Branch capacity ~equivalent to the existing California probe-card footprint, ramping end-2026 through 2027, with FY2026 cash capex guided **$140–170M** vs $104M in FY2025 [Actual, PRIMARY P1 capex series + call guide] — this step-up is why year-1 FCF sits *below* TTM owner earnings despite record profits; (iii) expanded multi-year Keystone Microtech partnership in the Taiwan ecosystem [Actual, PRIMARY P1]; (iv) **Deutsche Bank's claim that FORM is second source for Nvidia GPU probe cards at TSMC (~20% share, >$0.2B by 2028) appears in no filing — [Unconfirmed], single analyst note, Bull case only.**

**Owner earnings after SBC (mandate 2):** TTM owner earnings **$112M** = NI $115M + D&A $40M − capex $44M [Arithmetic, DATA 3]; SBC is already expensed in GAAP net income and is counted exactly once (`sbc_treatment: deducted_in_cf`). Base base_cf = **$103M** (desk default, TTM filed).

**Moat — seven factors (0–3 each):** switching costs/qualification lock-in 2 (multi-year customer co-development; Keystone partnership); IP/technical complexity 2 (HBM/advanced-packaging probe cards are genuinely hard); scale/cost position 2 (top-2 in probe cards vs Advantest/ASMPT); network effects 0; brand/franchise 1; distribution/access to TSMC–SK Hynix–Micron ecosystems 2 (Taiwan + South Korea = 56.1% of FY2025 revenue [Actual, PRIMARY P3]); proprietary process cost advantage 1. **Total 10/21 → 2.9/5 — a narrow moat, direction IMPROVING** (HBM mix, CPO entry, capacity optionality), but the business remains a cyclical equipment vendor: FY2023 revenue fell −11.4% and FCF was $9M in the last down phase [Actual, DATA 5].

**Financial strength:** Net cash **+$264M** (cash $103.3M + short-term investments $172.0M − debt $11.1M, FY2025 filed [Actual, PRIMARY P1/6C]); interest income ~$10.6M/yr; no leverage risk. Excess cash $275.2M added at face by the desk ($3.52/share).

---

## SECTION 3 — VALUATION

**Frame:** equity (all pack flows are after-interest; net debt is negative, so firm frame is inapplicable). **Discount rate:** COE ANCHOR 10.46% [Actual anchor], no departure. Bear carries +200 bps (12.46%) as the macro spread-widening shock (mandate 4).

**Inputs and departures from DEFAULTS:**

| Input | Value | Departure? | Reason (dated evidence) |
|---|---|---|---|
| base_cf | $103M | No | TTM filed owner-earnings default |
| SBC | deducted_in_cf | — | Already in GAAP NI; no double count |
| Base growth y1–y5 | −3% / +65% / +24% / +22% / +18% | **Yes (y1–y2 & y3–5)** | `guidance_deviation_reason`: the reference's y1/y2 ($0.166B/$0.223B) is built on consensus *non-GAAP* EPS with an unstated capex assumption; my GAAP-basis owner earnings use the company's own guided FY2026 cash capex of **$140–170M** (earnings call 2026-07-30) vs ~$60M D&A, which is why y1 = $99.9M (−3%) and y2 = $165M (+65%, FY2027 consensus revenue $1.203B [Estimate, DATA 8] with continued margin expansion). Years 3–5 (24/22/18%) exceed next-FY consensus revenue growth +17.1% and are kept on the company's own long-term model: **$1.6B revenue / 55% GM / >$5 EPS by 2030** (reiterated 2026-07-30) — full delivery lands FY2030 owner earnings near my year-5 level of ~$320M pre-WC [Assumption, construction from model + filed margin/capex trends] |
| fade_years | 5 | No | Default; reinvestment runway (Farmers Branch ramp through 2027) justifies a 5-year glide to terminal |
| terminal_g | 3.75% | No | Default (own FY2018–25 revenue trend 4.63%/yr held at the anchor) |
| terminal_ronic | 25.72% | No | Default = record's median return on tangible invested capital (2018–2025); no evidence to depart |
| Shares | 78,120,725 | No | Desk default; dilution factor 1.0141 < 1.05 threshold so not applied (filed H1 FY2026 diluted avg 79,546K [Actual, PRIMARY P1] is ~1.8% higher — immaterial, noted in Section 10) |
| Excess cash | $275.2M at face | No | Default; unrestricted cash + ST investments per filed balance sheet |
| Bull y1–y5 | −3% / +96% / +30% / +28% / +22% | **Yes (y2)** | `scenario_deviation_reason`: FY2027 at consensus high $1.353B [Estimate, DATA 8], non-GAAP GM holding ≥54% (Q3 guide 54.0% ± 1.5% [Actual, PRIMARY P1]), and the DB Nvidia second-source stream beginning to contribute in H2 2026 [Unconfirmed] |
| Bear y1–y5 | −12% / −11% / +15% / +20% / +15% at COE 12.46% | **Yes (y2)** | `scenario_deviation_reason`: AI/HBM capex digestion — FY2027 revenue at consensus **low** $1.049B [Estimate, DATA 8], non-GAAP GM compressing from the Q2 record 53.3% [Actual, PRIMARY P1] toward the FY2025 GAAP ~39% level, Farmers Branch pre-production ramp costs $25–30M (call, 2026-07-30), +200 bps COE shock; no contracted backlog floor exists (deferred revenue 9% of quarterly revenue) so FCF may fall to ~$51M in year 1 |

**Desk terminal:** Base terminal value $2.09B nominal ($841M PV, 42.1% of value), Gordon @ 3.75% on funded earnings at 25.7% RONIC → **implied terminal EV/FCF ≈ 15.5x** (Bear 11.9x). Against the MRI information_technology trailing-P/E band (median 28.0x, p25 14.1x, p75 60.0x [Aggregator]) and cluster-peer median trailing P/E of 56.7x, my terminal sits **~12.5 points below the sector median** — a conservative terminal (and an EV/FCF vs P/E metric mismatch that biases the comparison further toward me). Even this conservative terminal cannot approach the price.

**Reverse DCF (mandate 3b):** neutral structure (anchor COE, 10-yr fade) → **implied 10-year CAGR +29.07%**, which sits between the p50 (8.9%) and p90 (46.7%) of the <$1B size bucket [base-rate table] — but it is ~12x the company's own trailing 5-yr revenue CAGR (+2.5% [Actual, DATA 7]) and above what the company's own model supports beyond 2030 (fading to terminal thereafter). Under my own structure the implied Stage-1 growth is **+72.0%** and years 3–5 **+101.3%/yr**.

**Crux (stated disagreement with the price):**
- **Input:** `growth_years_3_5` — **mine +21.3%/yr avg (24/22/18%) vs price-implied +101.3%/yr.**
- **Size of disagreement:** ~80 points of annual cash-flow growth. ## SECTION 7 — RISKS

**Main risks to the AVOID call (i.e., how I lose):**
1. **Nvidia second-source confirmation at the Oct 6 summit** and a visible ramp to >$0.2B by 2028 — converts the Bull's key assumption from [Unconfirmed] to [Actual].

5. **Data risk:** my GAAP-basis owner-earnings construction is ~35–40% below the non-GAAP earnings path the market prices; if SBC/restructuring normalize faster than my path assumes, Base rises (but not by 5x).

**Pre-mortem — "the stock doubled again in five years and we were flat at zero weight: what went wrong?"** We under-weighted the *test-content* economics of AI accelerators: HBM stacks and CoWoS-scale panels multiply probe time per unit, so probe-card revenue grew with AI capex *squared*, not linearly; the Nvidia second-source claim was real and the market was early, not late; CPO became a genuine second engine by 2028; and the 39x multiple looked cheap in hindsight because EPS compounded at 40%+ for four years. The tell we would have missed: our Bear case assumed memory digestion that never came because AI demand absorbed all new HBM capacity — the FY2023 down phase was the last one.
